judgments.reason: The Data in Brief paper by Wirawan et al. 2024 describes the MIMED dataset (Emotiv EPOC X, 14 channels, 30 participants, motor imagery), matching this dataset's DOI, authors and acquisition.
judgments.paper_title: Acquisition and processing of Motor Imagery and Motor Execution Dataset (MIMED) for six movement activities

judgments.reason: The DANS/Mendeley 'MIMED' record is the original deposit of the same data: Wirawan et al., Emotiv EPOC X 14 channels, 30 Bali students, two days, motor imagery and execution.
MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used for dataset conversion, not a paper describing the MIMED2024 motor imagery dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data organization, a standard used by this dataset, not the MIMED2024 data paper (Wirawan et al., Data in Brief).
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
